Resolutions of 1980

23 resolutions, 35% unanimous. Late Cold War.

  • 462 (1980) Deciding to call an emergency special session of the General Assembly on the Afghanistan situation
  • 463 (1980) Calling upon United Kingdom to create conditions in Southern Rhodesia which will ensure free and fair elections
  • 464 (1980) Admission of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines to membership in the United Nations
  • 465 (1980) Israeli settlement policies in the occupied territories
  • 466 (1980) South Africa's military actions against Zambia
  • 467 (1980) Condemning the deliberate shelling of the headquarters of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 468 (1980) Deportation of Palestinian leaders from territories occupied by Israel
  • 469 (1980) Deportation of Palestinian leaders from territories occupied by Israel
  • 470 (1980) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 471 (1980) Assassination attempts against the Mayors of Nablus, Ramallah and Al Bireh
  • 472 (1980) Extending the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
  • 473 (1980) Calling upon South Africa to take measures to eliminate the policy of apartheid and grant to all South African citizens equal rights
  • 474 (1980) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 475 (1980) Policies of South Africa towards Angola
  • 476 (1980) The status of Jerusalem
  • 477 (1980) Admission of Zimbabwe to membership in the United Nations
  • 478 (1980) The status of Jerusalem
  • 479 (1980) Calling upon Iran and Iraq to refrain immediately from any further use of force and to accept any appropriate offer of mediation
  • 480 (1980) Election of members of the International Court of Justice
  • 481 (1980) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 482 (1980) Extension of the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
  • 483 (1980) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 484 (1980) Expulsion by Israel of the Mayors of Hebron and Halhoul

Security Council Record is an independent record of every resolution, vote and veto of the United Nations Security Council since 1946. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the United Nations. For official documents, use the Security Council website and the UN Digital Library.
